name: animated-tabs
blurb: Tabs with sliding indicator and direction-aware content transitions.
description: Context-based tab system (TabsProvider, TabsBtn, TabsContent) with Framer Motion animations. Active indicator slides into place; content fades and moves based on navigation direction. Optional wobbly effect.
use_when: Multi-section content (features, pricing tiers, overview/details) requiring smooth animated transitions.
avoid_when: Simple static tab navigation — adds Framer Motion dependency and animation overhead.
a11y: Tab buttons semantic, keyboard accessible by default. Content reachable. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
